title: A tiny load accumulates
hook: Two watts over a whole day and over one hour are different annual totals.

knows: that a model can declare hypothetical quantities
doesNotKnow: Convert a small stated constant load into a multiday energy quantity.

misconception: A small wattage cannot accumulate a meaningful quantity over many days.
objective: Convert a small stated constant load into a multiday energy quantity.

claims.text: A constant illustrative 2W load runs for either 24h/day or 1h/day. Scaled model; illustrative:2W;24h/day-or-1h/day;€0.30/kWh.
claims.source: Declared hypothetical inputs and limits in resource-specs.json. No actual product, price, tariff, shelf-life, treatment or physical appliance specification is asserted. claims.text: The stage's two results are computed by the printed expressions. At Days=365, A=17.52kWh and B=0.73kWh. Geometry follows the declared dimension relationships. Other pictures use a fixed full scale across the slider range; continuous fills and arcs show relative amounts rather than literal object counts.
